items.title: Tor groups compute the base change of Tor under flatness and colimit hypotheses
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the Tor groups of a base changed pair of algebras with the base change of the Tor groups of the original pair, under three flatness hypotheses, and the proof is a 31-line argument in three stages. It first constructs the canonical comparison map from the functoriality of Tor, then computes one of the intermediate Tor groups by a free resolution and uses flatness to identify it with a base change of Tor over the original ring, and finally uses Lazard's theorem to write the outer algebras as filtered colimits of finite free modules so that Tor commutes with the colimit and the identification becomes an isomorphism. Each of the three stages uses exactly one of the hypotheses, and all three are carried out in the source.
